notes.subject: o welago
notes.rationale: נפל: 'a wa' (boemong bja trance, KJV 'falling into a trance') kgathanong le 'o dutše a loile' (JPS, boemo bjo a se nago boitshimolo); mantšu ka moka a sekamilego ka diphuthelwana

notes.subject: מחזה/יחזה
notes.rationale: pono (מחזה) le go bona (יחזה) di bapana ka modumo — mahoko a mabedi a tšwa modungeni o tee, go se nago se swanago ka Sepeding

notes.subject: pono ya Shadai
notes.rationale: mmadi o laetša se sennwelo se sa bonagalego — dilo tše di kwalego tše di hlatsoago ke ba kgethilwego fela

translation: lentšu la yo a utlwago mantšu a El, yo a bonago pono ya Shadai, o welago gomme mahlo a butšwe:
